overview_description.description: Mandobk is a delivery platform that provides urban logistics and courier services. They enable consumers to purchase products online and get them delivered to their homes. They offer electronic appliances, mobiles, computers, clothing, and home essentials for delivery.

product.name: Food Delivery
product.description: A service for delivering meals quickly and efficiently, focusing on quality and convenience.

product.name: Parcel Delivery
product.description: Offers the delivery of parcels with an emphasis on speed and quality assurance, including a tracking system.

product.name: Restaurant Application
product.description: A user-friendly application for restaurants to receive orders, complemented by a dedicated order receiving device for each restaurant.

product.name: Courier Registration
product.description: Allows individuals to register as couriers, facilitating the delivery process.

product.name: Store Integration
product.description: Enables stores to integrate with the platform for efficient delivery services, even if the store is not registered in the app.

product.name: Multiple Payment Methods
product.description: Supports various payment methods for the convenience of users.
